    "(Tutorial_OpenMM_Add_point_harmonic_restraint)=\n",
    "# Add point harmonic restraint\n",
    "\n",
    "*Tethering atoms to target 3D Cartesian coordinates with harmonic positional restraints.*\n",
    "\n",
    "The function {func}`molsysmt.third_party.openmm.forces.add_point_harmonic_restraint` applies harmonic positional restraints to selected atoms relative to reference 3D coordinates.\n",
    "\n",
    ":::{versionadded} 1.0.0\n",
    ":::\n",
    "\n",
    ":::{admonition} API documentation\n",
    ":class: dropdown\n",
    "\n",
    "Follow this link for a detailed description of the input arguments, raised errors, and returned objects: {func}`molsysmt.third_party.openmm.forces.add_point_harmonic_restraint`.\n",
    ":::\n"
   ]

    "## Basic usage\n",
    "\n",
    "Let's add positional harmonic restraints to target coordinates:"
   ]

    "import molsysmt as msm\n",
    "\n",
    "molsys = msm.convert(msm.systems['Trp-Cage']['1l2y.h5msm'], to_form='molsysmt.MolSys')\n",
    "force = msm.third_party.openmm.forces.add_point_harmonic_restraint(molsys, point='[0,0,0] nm', selection=[0], force_constant='1000 kJ/(mol*nm**2)', return_force=True)\n",
    "print('Positional harmonic restraint created:', type(force))"
